title: Premium Homesite Points on Package Allowance Returns — Design Studio Selections
content:
Buyers on premium homesites receive points on package allowance returned to their Design Studio Selections file. Homesite points are set by the premium class of the Homesite Reservation converted into the purchase agreement the file serves:

| Class of the converted Homesite Reservation | Homesite points |
|---|---|
| Water-View Homesite or Golf-Frontage Homesite | 15 |
| Greenbelt Homesite or Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 10 |
| Any other class (Interior Homesite, Corner Homesite), or no converted reservation | None |

**Records read.** The Homesite Reservation linked on the Home Purchase Agreement as the reservation converted into it, and that reservation's homesite class.

*Hypothetical case:* a file whose agreement was converted from a Greenbelt Homesite reservation adds 10 points; a file whose agreement was signed without a reservation adds none.
